assertions.detail:
[claude-cli] r warmly and collected both name and phone number, but it then read back "next Thursday at 10 AM" when the caller had clearly asked for Tuesday — ignoring the caller's stated time. When corrected, rather than fixing the day and re-confirming, it apologized and transferred the caller to the front desk, so the date and time were never explicitly confirmed and the call ended abruptly without a polite close or resolution. Two of the rubric's explicit FAIL conditions (ignored the stated time, ended abruptly) are met, and the PASS requirement of explicit date/time confirmation is not.

VERDICT: FAIL
